# Contributing

How to propose a change to the specification, and the RFCs, are described in the contributing
guide on the website (branch `site`, `site/contributing.md`). Changes to the Python in-memory format
are pull requests against this branch; they follow released changes of
[scverse/spatialdata](https://github.com/scverse/spatialdata), where the format is discussed. A
change that also needs the data model changed goes with a pull request against the branch
`data-model`.
